trans-unit.target: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_000<tab>Right. I've rebuilt yer weapon's core usin' the ecliptic arcanite ye procured.
TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_003<tab>Another resoundin' success. Yer weapon's free from its illusory shroud, an' all them enhancements are completely untouched.
TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_004<tab>Behold the true, unfettered power o' me latest creation: <var 31 ((Item)) 03E8020202 /var>!
TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_005<tab>Behold the true, unfettered power o' me latest creations: <var 31 ((Item)) 03E8020202 /var> an' <var 31 ((Item)) 03E8030202 /var>!
TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_006<tab>As yer well aware, the best is yet to come. Only once yer phantom weapon's filled to the brim with martial memories can we call the bleedin' job done!
TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_007<tab>There's enough ecliptic arcanite left over, so I can soon get crackin'. Dodokkuli'll handle the grunt work first, mind.

TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_008<tab>As good as yer phantom weapon feels right now, know that there's plenty more power to wring out o' the thing. Can't leave that potential untapped, can we?
